title: Dinosaur Island: Rawr 'n Write — Digital Hot-seat
summary: A fan-made digital hot-seat version of the roll-and-write board game, with its rules running as a tested state machine.
description: A fan-made digital hot-seat adaptation of the roll-and-write board game Dinosaur Island: Rawr 'n Write. The game rules run as a tested state machine kept separate from the React UI, so every player action is validated before the game state changes.
highlights: Rules engine modelled as a state machine — the UI only renders state and submits one legal action at a time
Pending work (placements, disasters, rewards) must be resolved before a turn can advance; stale or wrong-player actions are rejected
Covered by 1,000+ automated engine and store tests with Vitest
Runs as a desktop app built with Vite and Electron, with local save games
